text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Nature & Ikuno
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year. Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a new year, and Matikanetannhauser has brought her friends to hang out in my office.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The thing is, we all made mochi together and I wanted to share some with you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Don't mention it! And also… Is it still in your office?
choice_data_list: Is what still in my office?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You know what! The kotatsu!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hurriedly invite the four cold Umamusume into my office to warm up under the kotatsu.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Look, Nature! I'm a snail!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, stop messing around… But wow, they really are the best. I can feel my fatigue just melting away.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Right?! There's no better way to spend New Year's than chowing down on some mochi and oranges under the kotatsu.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser, shouldn't you show your trainer that thing we were discussing?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh! Right! Take a look at this, Trainer. It's this month's Twinkle Monthly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah! Look, it's got my name written in it right here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look where she's pointing and, sure enough, the name "Matikanetannhauser" is written in small print.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's a feature on up-and-comers! It says, "The race gave me the impression she could go on to do great things."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take a closer look, thinking it would be best to read it carefully since she brought it all the way over here, when…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smack-dab in the center of the page, I see the words "Mihono Bourbon: Top Pick for Triple Crown Champion" written much larger.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon has been in the spotlight for some time, but… Hm. I didn't realize expectations were this high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The size of a headline indicates the level of interest and the current public sentiment. Seeing this would unnerve anyone prone to worrying over such things.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You're right. Tannhauser is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow, they wrote about Bourbon too! Top pick for the Triple Crown? That's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: She works so hard every day, I can see why people have such high hopes for her. She's always running up and down that ramp…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll just have to work hard too! That's it, I'm aiming to be Triple Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Ah, sorry. I interrupted you two, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'll be cheering you on from the sidelines. Keep going just the way you are this year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few hours later…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's time for our first ever heart-pounding New Year's Luck Tourney!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Somehow, everyone has ended up playing New Year's games.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Now then, this tournament will have three events! The first is the "Stick-it-Out Kendama Showdown," where whoever takes the ball around the world first wins!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Next is the "Running Kite Showdown," where the person who flies their kite highest wins!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Finally, we have the "You Laugh, You Lose Fukuwarai Showdown!" Arrange your facial features the best to win!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: As for which game comes first, that's up to the owner of this office—Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I guess the first one I want to try is…
choice_data_list: The "You Laugh, You Lose Fukuwarai Showdown"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Great choice! I've actually picked out a spacious spot that's perfect for this game! Drumroll please…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Near the overpass!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: This does appear to be an apt location. There are no other people around, and not a power line in sight.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! Then let's get this match underway! Trainer's the judge!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo engine… engage!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wow, that's really high! Not bad, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! I can go even faster than that! Rrraaagh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to withstand such intense acceleration, the kite string breaks, and the kite itself disappears from sight almost instantly.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Aaagh! My kite!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh no. That's… really far away.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, if we're just considering height, Turbo's the winner, right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I suppose so. Assuming she's not disqualified, of course.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I won?! Aaawesome! Yesss!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, great job!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As our day of fun comes to an end, the curtain rises on the second year of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ooh, nice choice! I've actually been doing a little practice recently!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Going around the world means catching the ball in the small cup, then the big cup, then the middle cup and, finally, on the spike!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Everyone ready? And… go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hup, hah… Gah!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Arrrgh! I was so close!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sound of clacking wood echoes throughout my office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And night falls…

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: This task is… far more difficult than I had anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Don't sweat it! It's not over yet!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Grr! I can keep going too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uh, my hand's starting to hurt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As our day of fun comes to an end, the curtain rises on the second year of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! I've actually prepared a special fukuwarai set!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she says this, she takes out a paper nose, eyes, and other facial features, as well as sheet of paper with the outline of…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I made a set based on Trainer's face!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm the one who looks at Trainer's face the most, so I should have this in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: In fact, there's no way I can lose! Let's throw down!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmmm, is this… the mouth?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. You've got it wrong, Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What?! Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Button it, Turbo! Don't help her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After some more fiddling around, the result is…

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: The nose is in the correct place, but the mouth is wrong. You get seventy-five points!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Gyah! I didn't get a perfect score!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Trainer! How did I mess this up?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As our day of fun comes to an end, the curtain rises on the second year of the Twinkle Series.
